// diagnostic

E0225

This mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

What

This mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

Why

A mark belongs only on a write window bound to a name, a match that writes into its subject, and `task &&name`, and `x.move()` takes a name or one of its fields. Read calls and fresh values such as literals and call results take no mark, and a collection element stays in its collection.

Fix

Remove the mark.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0225: tests/ui/move_mark_borrowed.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingMoveMarker]: `xs` cannot be moved from borrowed storage
  --> tests/ui/move_mark_borrowed.jet:8:13
    |
  8 |     Box{xs: xs.move()}
    |             ^^^^^^^
 Why: Read and write parameters and named windows keep ownership with their source
 Fix: Copy the value with `xs.copy()`, or declare the parameter `xs: &&[Int]` to take ownership
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0201

Error [jet.UnusedPlaceMark]: `.move()` takes a named place, not this value
  --> tests/ui/move_mark_borrowed.jet:17:14
    |
 17 |     first := grid[0].move()
    |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `.move()` moves a name or one of its fields out of its owner; an element stays owned by its collection, and a call result or literal is already new
 Fix: Move the whole collection or name, or drop `.move()` from a fresh value
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0225
